items.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Who’s the guy with the raindrops? Not Burt Bacharach, the other guy.

ctx.x: I did stuff for Blood, Sweat & Tears, I did stuff for Bob Dylan. Who’s the guy with the raindrops? Not Burt Bacharach, the other guy.
